values.note: One loop of back-in sites with paved spurs. Trailer limits per site: 16 sites take 28 ft and site 1 takes 25 ft; sites 9 (18), 11, 20, 22 (20), 10, 12, 13 (15) and 15 (13) are too short for a 23-ft rig; site 18 lists none.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/pocket-recreation-area ('RV maximum length 28 feet') + recreation.gov campsites API permitted_equipment Trailer max_length for each of the 26 sites, read 2026-10-30

facilities.source: recreation.gov 10296890 ('a restroom with flush toilets centrally located (no showers). Water hydrants are located throughout', 'There is no dump station') + FS page ('Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-30

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/pocket-recreation-area ('Seasons of Use: April - October 31') + recreation.gov rate season 2026-04-01..2026-11-01 and the availability calendar (bookable nights end 2026-10-31), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations only (the Forest Service ended walk-up). Recreation.gov or 877-444-6777. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm; arrive by noon the day after the first reserved night or the reservation may be cancelled. 14 days in any 30 on the forest. The next season goes on sale as a block, not on a rolling 6-month window.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/pocket-recreation-area ('The Pocket campground has transitioned to reservations only', '14-day limit') + recreation.gov notices ('Check-Out time: 2:00 pm Check-In time: 3:00 pm', '14-Day Forest Stay Limit') and overrideSlidingWindow rule, read 2026-10-30

note: USFS Chattahoochee NF, in a limestone valley between Horn and Mill mountains in NW Georgia; Spring Branch creek runs through the adjacent picnic area. Paved access road. Cell service very limited; nearest store and gas 8 miles away in Villanow. Alcohol prohibited in the whole recreation area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15, 26 non-electric back-in sites, flush toilets, hydrant water, no showers/dump, RV max 28 ft. Added: season Apr 1 - Oct 31 (FS page + rec.gov calendar), reservations-only (fcfs none), 14-night limit, check-in/out, Senior/Access 50%. Per-site lengths: 17 of 26 sites take a 23-ft rig. Old fs.usda.gov/recarea link replaced with the r08 page. Note trimmed of field facts.
